entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return this VeloBand GPS tracker I bought. It's just not for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's nothing wrong with it. Honestly, I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it like I thought I would.
I understand. Let me just pull up your account with your phone number... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered on January 4th, which was 12 days ago.
Right. So process the return for me.

I've reviewed the details, and I'm afraid I won't be able to process a return for this item. The VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return policy, which is noted on its product page. This is because once activated, the device links to a user's account and for hygiene reasons, we cannot accept it back.
ARE YOU SERIOUS?! TEN DAYS?! What kind of a garbage policy is that? I want to speak to your manager right now! This is completely unacceptable!

I understand your frustration, sir, and I'm sorry for the disappointing news. The 10-day policy for the Pulse is a firm company policy, and my manager would have to provide you with the same information.

This is ridiculous! I'm going to light you guys up on social media! Everyone is going to know VeloFit rips people off with these hidden policies! You're going to lose a lot more money than the cost of this stupid band!

I certainly don't want you to have that impression of us. While a direct return for a refund isn't an option after the 10-day window has passed, I do have a very good alternative that many of our customers use.
What, a 10% off coupon for my trouble? Save it.

Not at all. We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform we host for our community to buy and sell their gently used VeloFit gear. Since your band is practically new, you can list it there and likely recoup most of what you paid. It's a very popular and secure option for resale.
A resale marketplace? So I can just sell it to someone else through your site?
Exactly. We provide the secure platform, you create the listing and set the price, and another VeloFit enthusiast gets a great device. Would you like me to email you the direct link to get started?
...Okay. Fine. Yeah, that's... actually a decent solution. Send me the link.
Of course. I've just sent that to the email address we have on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
